item.title: Book a library study room
item.context_text: You and two friends need a room to practise for a presentation. Check the library's rules and message your group.
item.objective_text: Choose a time that works and explain how to keep the booking.
item.target_grammar: Can for rules and requests. Before and after for times.
success_conditions: Choose a time that works and explain how to keep the booking.

children.title: Check the details
children.instructions: Read the message and use its details to answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
LIBRARY STUDY ROOM
Thursday slots: 3:00–3:45 or 4:30–5:15. A room holds up to four people. Book at the desk with your library card. If you are ten minutes late, staff may give your room to another group. The three of you finish class at 4:00.

questions.prompt: Which slot fits the group's schedule?
questions.explanation: The group finishes class at 4:00. Of the two listed slots, only 4:30 starts after class.

questions.prompt: By what time should the group arrive to avoid losing the 4:30 booking?
questions.explanation: Staff may give the room away when a group is ten minutes late, so arrive before 4:40.

children.title: Message your group
children.instructions: Send a group message with the time and the item you need at the desk.
children.prompt_text: Nodira: Can we still book a room after class?
children.goal: Confirm the slot and tell the group what to bring.
children.model_answer: Yes! We can book the room at 4:30 on Thursday. I'll bring my library card so we can book it at the desk.

children.title: Ask the librarian to book it
children.instructions: Make a polite request and give your group size and preferred slot.
children.prompt_text: Librarian: Hello! How can I help?
children.goal: Request the correct booking for three people.
children.model_answer: Could I book the study room for three people at 4:30 on Thursday, please?
